**Trace**

1. Argument resolution with no PR token: no-token discovery, run before any set-vs-single branch, run folder, continuation record, tracker init or provisioning.
2. `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. After stripping `.git` and lowercasing, the repository is `acme/widgets`.
3. `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`, stored as `viewer.login`.
4. `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` succeeds with an empty list, stored as `viewer.teams` (readable, no teams).
5. The discovery block runs once: `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json ... --jq "$projection"`.
   - It exits 0.
   - Validation passes: the output is an array of 3 objects, each with an integer `number`, and 3 is below the limit of 1000.
   - Filtering removes nothing: no row is a draft, approved or `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, so no review lookup runs.
   - PR 999 on the current branch is ignored, because discovery never falls back to the current branch.
6. **Ticket links are resolved here.** This happens before the final sort.
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` names origin's default branch.
   - `git show <ref>:<path>` reads the overrides in search order (`.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`, first found). It yields `tracker: github`, which disables Linear IDs, addresses and lookups.
   - No PR has closing references.
   - The branches `retry`, `elapsed` and `trim-labels` carry no `gh-<N>`.
   - No title carries `#<N>` or `gh-<N>`.
   - Result: every PR shows `no ticket`.
7. **Final sort happens here**, by additions + deletions, then number: #101 (2), #97 (4), #112 (6). There are 3 matches and the harness is Claude Code, so the "2+ Claude Code" row applies. The `reference/batch.md` read is skipped, and the pi `parallel.maxTasks` of 4 is never consulted.
8. **Reply 1** carries **the first tool call after the sort**: a read of `brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md` `## First-line rule`, which holds the stop-format instructions.
   - Its visible text is the discovered list.
   - It has no marker, no question and no wait.
9. **Reply 2** is the separate stop message: the `stuck` marker, the harness rejection line, and one `discovered, smallest first:` line. Discovery ends at this rejection. No gating, provisioning or helper dispatch runs.

---

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - retries requests that respond slowly
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - shows elapsed time
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trims empty labels

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
## Chronological trace

All calls below are narrated only; no tools are executed.

1. **Argument resolution:** Read `verification-brief.md`, Section A. The invocation has no PR token, so discovery runs against origin, not the current branch's unrelated PR.
2. **Command:** `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Normalize the repository identity to `acme/widgets`.
3. **Command:** `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
4. **Command:** `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns an empty list.
5. **Command:** Run the single discovery query, using Section A's projection:
   `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json number,url,isDraft,reviewDecision,additions,deletions,title,author,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests,body --jq "$projection"`
6. **Validate and filter:** Validate the complete result as an array of three objects with integer PR numbers. The count is below the query limit. All three PRs survive filtering; none needs a change-request review lookup.
7. **Ticket resolution:** Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`, then read the default-branch overrides with `git show <resolved-ref>:<path>` in the prescribed search order: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`, stopping at the first existing file. The supplied overrides select GitHub tickets, disabling Linear guesses and lookups. No PR has a GitHub ticket reference, so each displays `no ticket`.
8. **Final sort:** Sort by additions plus deletions, then PR number: **101, 97, 112**.
9. **Reply 1 / first call after the sort:** Reply 1 carries the linked discovery list below and the narrated file read of `../brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md`'s first-line rule. This is the first tool call after sorting. Do not read `reference/batch.md`.
10. **Reply 2 / rejection:** Emit the separate three-line rejection below. Initialize no run folder, continuation record, or tracker stages. Run no fetch, provisioning, verification, or review; dispatch no helpers. No SHA is assessed, and no report or menu is rendered.

---

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - retry slow requests
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - show elapsed time
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trim empty labels
